verdict.rationale: The Department of State publishes a public 'Search Corporations and Business Entities' database showing whether an entity is active or inactive, plus a public license-record search. A founder can therefore confirm the outcome or standing of a completed filing from public pages, but nothing shows a way to track a pending filing, application, or case; in-process status arrives only as an emailed acknowledgement or by phone. Missing for 10: public tracking of pending filing or application status, case/complaint status lookup, and hands-on corroboration of the search tools (the filing host refused connections to the probe).
